I'll start by discovering the tools available on the three MCP servers.

Page 4 timed out, so I'll retry it. I'll also start searching the docs.

The search returns snippets, not full bodies. I'll try queries built to surface body lines.

The docs only come back as truncated snippets, so I'll probe them with targeted words.

Now the checks doc.

Rules and approvers are clear enough. Now I'll read the tickets.

Now the resolved onboarding tickets, which count as already onboarded, and the inventory.

MR-4112 is discontinued, so 1620 is ineligible. I'll check how 1602's transfer was booked, to confirm the destination warehouse names.

The decisions are settled. I'll process the tickets in id order, starting with 1604 (onboarded, 12 units released to `north`).

The call timed out, so I don't know whether it applied. I'll check the adjustments before retrying.

The minus side applied despite the timeout, so I'll book only the plus side.

The 1604 comment hit a connection reset. I'll retry it with the same idempotency key, which can't create a duplicate, and set statuses for 1605–1608.

Now 1618 (TLM, onboarded under EX-44), then 1619 through 1623.

Everything is applied. I'll write the status file.

I processed all 16 open `supplier-onboarding` requests in id order and added one comment and one status change to each. I wrote `/app/STATUS.json` with status `success`.

The docs service only returns truncated snippets, so I couldn't read some lines in full. I pieced them together by probing with search terms. Two rules are inferred, not read in full:
- **Tolerance boundary:** a trial fails only when failed units are more than 10% of the trial units, so exactly 10% passes. The 10% figure is confirmed. The "more than" wording is inferred.
- **Self-approval:** nobody may approve a request they requested. I read this as the "Requested by" person on the ticket.

| Ticket | Code | Decision | Status |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1604 | KVW | Onboarded; 12 units moved from `inspection` to `north` | resolved |
| 1605 | CPK | Waiting for approval: finance (EX-45 only starts 2026-09-20) | pending |
| 1606 | PFS | Waiting for approval: finance (`d.fuentes` is not a finance approver) | pending |
| 1607 | NTE | Waiting for approval: procurement (the requester's approval doesn't count, and the other was withdrawn) | pending |
| 1608 | RHE | Waiting for approval: compliance (the comment isn't the exact approval text) | pending |
| 1610 | QSR | Waiting for approval: compliance | pending |
| 1611 | LGC | Onboarded; 4 units moved to `hazmat` | resolved |
| 1612 | VCT | Onboarded; 10 units moved to `west` (EX-41 waives finance) | resolved |
| 1614 | LHJ | Waiting for approval: compliance (EX-38 expired) | pending |
| 1616 | AUC | Onboarded; 18 units moved to `east` (2 of 20 failed, which is exactly 10%) | resolved |
| 1617 | BHS | Rejected: trial failed inspection (3 of 20 failed); 17 units returned by `shipment` | closed |
| 1618 | TLM | Onboarded; 8 units moved to `north` (2 of 10 failed, within the 20% tolerance from EX-44) | resolved |
| 1619 | MLE | Waiting for trial delivery: 18 of 24 units received | pending |
| 1620 | RBT | Rejected: item not eligible (MR-4112 is discontinued) | closed |
| 1621 | SRT | Duplicate: SRT already onboarded (ticket 1602) | duplicate |
| 1623 | VCT | Duplicate: VCT already onboarded (ticket 1612) | duplicate |

Two calls timed out, and neither left a duplicate:
- **1604 stock move:** the first `adjust_stock` call timed out but had applied. I checked the adjustments and booked only the missing plus side.
- **1604 comment:** it hit a connection reset. The retry used the same idempotency key and returned the original comment.

I made no stock moves for any pending ticket. All moves are booked under `ONB-<ticket id>`.
